
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/felix-space/p/19068104" title="发布于 2025-09-01 13:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">UniswapV2Periphery 源码学习</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>Periphery是uniswap的外围合约，将core合约封装起来提供给外部调用，比如我们在网页操作Swap时，请求的就是Periphery的合约。</p>
<p>Periphery里面写了Migrator和Router两个合约，其中Migrator是迁移合约，将流动性从Uniswap的V1版本迁移到V2版本，不涉及swap的功能，这里就不写了。</p>
<h1 id="router合约">Router合约</h1>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">    using SafeMath for uint;

    address public immutable override factory;
    address public immutable override WETH;

    modifier ensure(uint deadline) {
        require(deadline &gt;= block.timestamp, 'UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED');
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _factory, address _WETH) public {
        factory = _factory;
        WETH = _WETH;
    }

    receive() external payable {
        assert(msg.sender == WETH); // only accept ETH via fallback from the WETH contract
    }
</code></pre>
<p>从基础部分开始看起，router合约中记录了<code>factory</code>和<code>WETH</code>地址，其中<code>factory</code>用于获取<code>pair</code>和创建新的<code>pair</code>合约，而特别记录下<code>WETH</code>的地址是为了支持以太坊链的主网币<code>ETH</code>。</p>
<p>Uniswap中的代币操作都是基于<code>ERC20</code>类型，但是ETH本身既不是<code>ERC20</code>，也没有合约地址，因此为了<code>ETH</code>也能参与swap，需要先将<code>ETH</code>转换成<code>WETH</code>，再进行后续的操作。Uniswap为了减少用户手动转换的麻烦，会在有<code>ETH</code>参与的交易中自动执行<code>ETH</code>与<code>WETH</code>的相互转换，因此需要记录下<code>WETH</code>的合约地址。</p>
<p><code>receive</code>方法中限制了只允许接收来自<code>WETH</code>合约的ETH，即调用<code>withdraw</code>方法取出ETH，除此之外不可直接向合约中转入ETH。</p>
<h2 id="addliquidity">addLiquidity</h2>
<p><code>addLiquidity</code>是向合约添加流动性的方法，其主要逻辑在<code>_addLiquidity</code>中，根据用户提供的token数量，再根据流动性池中已有的token数量，计算出实际参与添加流动性的token数量，返回两个uint值：</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function _addLiquidity(
    address tokenA,
    address tokenB,
    uint amountADesired,
    uint amountBDesired,
    uint amountAMin,
    uint amountBMin
) internal virtual returns (uint amountA, uint amountB) {
    // create the pair if it doesn't exist yet
    if (IUniswapV2Factory(factory).getPair(tokenA, tokenB) == address(0)) {
        IUniswapV2Factory(factory).createPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    }
    (uint reserveA, uint reserveB) = UniswapV2Library.getReserves(factory, tokenA, tokenB);
    if (reserveA == 0 &amp;&amp; reserveB == 0) {
        (amountA, amountB) = (amountADesired, amountBDesired);
    } else {
        uint amountBOptimal = UniswapV2Library.quote(amountADesired, reserveA, reserveB);
        if (amountBOptimal &lt;= amountBDesired) {
            require(amountBOptimal &gt;= amountBMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_B_AMOUNT');
            (amountA, amountB) = (amountADesired, amountBOptimal);
        } else {
            uint amountAOptimal = UniswapV2Library.quote(amountBDesired, reserveB, reserveA);
            assert(amountAOptimal &lt;= amountADesired);
            require(amountAOptimal &gt;= amountAMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_A_AMOUNT');
            (amountA, amountB) = (amountAOptimal, amountBDesired);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>第一步判断交易对是否存在，如果不存在那么调用<code>facotry</code>创建一个新的交易对。</p>
<p>如果此时流动性池为空，那么用户提供的数量就是最后实际添加到池子中的数量，无需进一步计算；但如果池子非空，就需要通过<code>UniswapV2Library</code>中的<code>quote</code>方法去计算合理的数量。</p>
<p>quote方法如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function quote(uint amountA, uint reserveA, uint reserveB) internal pure returns (uint amountB) {
    require(amountA &gt; 0, 'UniswapV2Library: INSUFFICIENT_AMOUNT');
    require(reserveA &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; reserveB &gt; 0, 'UniswapV2Library: INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY');
    amountB = amountA.mul(reserveB) / reserveA;
}
</code></pre>
<p>逻辑很简单，就是根据A和B当前数量的比值，计算新增数量的A需要匹配多少数量的B，保证最终池子内A与B的比值不变。</p>
<p>回到<code>_addLiquidity</code>的逻辑，先根据A传入的数量去计算出需要多少相匹配的B，如果传入的B数量满足，那么就以<code>amountADesired, amountBOptimal</code>作为最后添加到流动性池子的数量；如果不满足，说明B相对池子的数量较少，那么就以B的数量为基准，反过来去计算所需要A的数量。在计算中，还需要满足<code>amountMin</code>的限制。</p>
<p>了解了主要逻辑之后，再回归到<code>addLiquidity</code>方法本身就很简单了：</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function addLiquidity(
    address tokenA,
    address tokenB,
    uint amountADesired,
    uint amountBDesired,
    uint amountAMin,
    uint amountBMin,
    address to,
    uint deadline
) external virtual override ensure(deadline) returns (uint amountA, uint amountB, uint liquidity) {
    (amountA, amountB) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, amountAMin, amountBMin);
    address pair = UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB);
    TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, pair, amountA);
    TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(tokenB, msg.sender, pair, amountB);
    liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>pairFor</code>方法就是之前提到过的唯一pair地址生成器，根据factory，tokenA和tokenB的地址就能生成对应的pair地址，无需去factory中查询。</p>
<p><code>safeTransferFrom</code>是uniswap封装的转账方法，因为标准的ERC20实现中tranferFrom要求返回bool，但是实际有许多代币在实现的时候并没有遵守这一规则，导致返回内容各不相同，还可能不返回，因此通过底层调用的绕过类型检查的限制，并且手动根据返回的data元数据进行判断调用是否成功，保证了对不同token的兼容。</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function safeTransferFrom(
    address token,
    address from,
    address to,
    uint256 value
) internal {
    // bytes4(keccak256(bytes('transferFrom(address,address,uint256)')));
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x23b872dd, from, to, value));
    require(
        success &amp;&amp; (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))),
        'TransferHelper::transferFrom: transferFrom failed'
    );
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="addliquidityeth">addLiquidityETH</h3>
<p><code>addLiquidityETH</code>的使用场景是交易中存在一方为ETH的时候，需要执行前面提到的<code>WETH</code>转换操作，并且ETH是通过<code>msg.Value</code>的形式传递的，所以对于多余的部分，需要手动执行退回。</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function addLiquidityETH(
    address token,
    uint amountTokenDesired,
    uint amountTokenMin,
    uint amountETHMin,
    address to,
    uint deadline
) external virtual override payable ensure(deadline) returns (uint amountToken, uint amountETH, uint liquidity) {
    (amountToken, amountETH) = _addLiquidity(
        token,
        WETH,
        amountTokenDesired,
        msg.value,
        amountTokenMin,
        amountETHMin
    );
    address pair = UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, token, WETH);
    TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, pair, amountToken);
    IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amountETH}();
    assert(IWETH(WETH).transfer(pair, amountETH));
    liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);
    // refund dust eth, if any
    if (msg.value &gt; amountETH) TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(msg.sender, msg.value - amountETH);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="removeliquidity">removeLiquidity</h2>
<p><code>removeLiquidity</code>的基本逻辑：</p>
<ul>
<li>获取交易对<code>Pair</code></li>
<li>将<code>sender</code>的<code>LP token发送</code>到<code>Pair</code></li>
<li>调用<code>burn</code>方法，销毁<code>LP token</code>，将两种<code>token</code>发回给用户，并得到<code>tokenA</code>和<code>tokenB</code>的数量</li>
<li>保证数量满足<code>min</code>的要求</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function removeLiquidity(
    address tokenA,
    address tokenB,
    uint liquidity,
    uint amountAMin,
    uint amountBMin,
    address to,
    uint deadline
) public virtual override ensure(deadline) returns (uint amountA, uint amountB) {
    address pair = UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB);
    IUniswapV2Pair(pair).transferFrom(msg.sender, pair, liquidity); // send liquidity to pair
    (uint amount0, uint amount1) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).burn(to);
    (address token0,) = UniswapV2Library.sortTokens(tokenA, tokenB);
    (amountA, amountB) = tokenA == token0 ? (amount0, amount1) : (amount1, amount0);
    require(amountA &gt;= amountAMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_A_AMOUNT');
    require(amountB &gt;= amountBMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_B_AMOUNT');
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="removeliquidityeth">removeLiquidityETH</h3>
<p><code>removeLiquidityETH</code>同样是用于ETH参与交易对的场景，可以看到这里直接调用了<code>removeLiquidity</code>，但调用的时候<code>to</code>参数传的是路由合约的地址<code>address(this)</code>，这意味着<code>burn</code>取回流动性之后，代币会先发送到路由合约上。因此下面的逻辑补上了从路由合约将token和ETH转回到to地址的过程。</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function removeLiquidityETH(
    address token,
    uint liquidity,
    uint amountTokenMin,
    uint amountETHMin,
    address to,
    uint deadline
) public virtual override ensure(deadline) returns (uint amountToken, uint amountETH) {
    (amountToken, amountETH) = removeLiquidity(
        token,
        WETH,
        liquidity,
        amountTokenMin,
        amountETHMin,
        address(this),
        deadline
    );
    TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, to, amountToken);
    IWETH(WETH).withdraw(amountETH);
    TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(to, amountETH);
}
</code></pre>
<p>这么写是因为：</p>
<ul>
<li>需要处理<code>WETH</code>和<code>ETH</code>的转换，因此必须将<code>WETH</code>先取出，存到路由合约中</li>
<li>复用了<code>removeLiquidity</code>逻辑，简化代码</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="其他remove">其他remove</h3>
<p>uniswap中还支持了<code>removeLiquidityWithPermit</code>和<code>removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens</code>这两种类型，其中<code>WithPermit</code>是基于EIP712实现的链下签名代执行的方法，而<code>SupportingFeeOnTransferTokens</code>则是支持特殊的ERC20token，这种token会在交易的过程中收取手续费或者燃烧，因为不涉及核心逻辑，所以就不深入了。</p>
<h2 id="swap">swap</h2>
<p>swap有四种类型：</p>
<ul>
<li>swapExactTokensForTokens，拿指定数量的A换B</li>
<li>swapTokensForExactTokens，拿A换指定数量的B</li>
<li>swapExactETHForTokens，拿指定数量的ETH换token</li>
<li>swapTokensForExactETH，拿ETH换指定数量的token</li>
</ul>
<p>可以看到，关键的区别在于<strong>先确定输入还是先确定输出</strong>，以及<strong>是否有ETH的参与。</strong></p>
<p>以<code>swapExactTokensForTokens</code>为例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function swapExactTokensForTokens(
    uint amountIn,
    uint amountOutMin,
    address[] calldata path,
    address to,
    uint deadline
) external virtual override ensure(deadline) returns (uint[] memory amounts) {
    amounts = UniswapV2Library.getAmountsOut(factory, amountIn, path);
    require(amounts[amounts.length - 1] &gt;= amountOutMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT');
    TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(
        path[0], msg.sender, UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, path[0], path[1]), amounts[0]
    );
    _swap(amounts, path, to);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>path</code>是token转换的路径，因为对于用户想要提供A换取B的场景， 可能没有现成的A-B池子，那么就需要一条路径，先将A换成C，再从C换成B，最典型的C就是<code>WETH</code>，因为绝大部分的代币都会优先提供和<code>WETH</code>组成的交易对，那么只要通过WETH，基本上就可以实现任意两种代币的兑换。</p>
<p>根据<code>path</code>可以得到<code>amounts</code>，即转换路径上每种代币应有的数量，因为这里是已知输入的方法，所以用到了<code>getAmountsOut</code>方法：</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function getAmountsOut(address factory, uint amountIn, address[] memory path) internal view returns (uint[] memory amounts) {
    require(path.length &gt;= 2, 'UniswapV2Library: INVALID_PATH');
    amounts = new uint[](path.length);
    amounts[0] = amountIn;
    for (uint i; i &lt; path.length - 1; i++) {
        (uint reserveIn, uint reserveOut) = getReserves(factory, path[i], path[i + 1]);
        amounts[i + 1] = getAmountOut(amounts[i], reserveIn, reserveOut);
    }
}

function getAmountOut(uint amountIn, uint reserveIn, uint reserveOut) internal pure returns (uint amountOut) {
      require(amountIn &gt; 0, 'UniswapV2Library: INSUFFICIENT_INPUT_AMOUNT');
      require(reserveIn &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; reserveOut &gt; 0, 'UniswapV2Library: INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY');
      uint amountInWithFee = amountIn.mul(997);
      uint numerator = amountInWithFee.mul(reserveOut);
      uint denominator = reserveIn.mul(1000).add(amountInWithFee);
      amountOut = numerator / denominator;
  }
</code></pre>
<p><code>getAmountsOut</code>即轮询path中的代币组合，模拟<code>token</code>的<code>swap</code>；<code>getAmountOut</code>是对于已知<code>reserve</code>的<code>pair</code>，提供<code>amountIn</code>得到<code>amountOut</code>。</p>
<p><code>getAmountOut</code>中是以下数学逻辑的实现：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>交换前：x × y = k<br>
交换后：(x + Δx) × (y - Δy) = k</p>
<p>因为k是常数，所以：<br>
x × y = (x + Δx) × (y - Δy)</p>
<p>展开：<br>
x × y = x × y - x × Δy + Δx × y - Δx × Δy</p>
<p>简化：<br>
0 = -x × Δy + Δx × y - Δx × Δy<br>
x × Δy = Δx × y - Δx × Δy<br>
x × Δy = Δx × (y - Δy)</p>
<p>求解Δy：<br>
Δy = (Δx × y) / (x + Δx)</p>
</blockquote>
<p>也就是<code>amountOut = (amountIn × reserveOut) / (reserveIn + amountIn)</code>。</p>
<p>因为uniswap中会收取0.3%的手续费，所以实际的amountIn是 <code>amountIn *997/100</code>，为了避免浮点数运算，分子分母都乘以1000，最终得到<code>amountOut = (amountIn × 997 × reserveOut) / (reserveIn × 1000 + amountIn × 997)</code>。</p>
<p>计算出<code>amounts</code>后，将<code>input token</code>发送到即<code>path[0]</code>和<code>path[1]</code>组成的流动性池，调用<code>_swap</code>进行链式的交换，直到最终得到<code>output</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function _swap(uint[] memory amounts, address[] memory path, address _to) internal virtual {
    for (uint i; i &lt; path.length - 1; i++) {
        (address input, address output) = (path[i], path[i + 1]);
        (address token0,) = UniswapV2Library.sortTokens(input, output);
        uint amountOut = amounts[i + 1];
        (uint amount0Out, uint amount1Out) = input == token0 ? (uint(0), amountOut) : (amountOut, uint(0));
        address to = i &lt; path.length - 2 ? UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, output, path[i + 2]) : _to;
        IUniswapV2Pair(UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, input, output)).swap(
            amount0Out, amount1Out, to, new bytes(0)
        );
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>_swap主要做了参数的处理工作，遍历<code>path</code>和<code>amounts</code>得到<code>input</code>，<code>output</code>，<code>amount0Out</code>，<code>amount1Out</code>等参数，传入Pair合约的<code>swap</code>方法中进行实际的swap工作。</p>
<p>注意的几个点：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>amountOut</code>等于<code>amounts[i+1]</code>且需要分配给非<code>input</code>的<code>token</code>作为<code>amount</code>。</li>
<li>swap的时候，<code>path[i]</code>和<code>path[i+1]</code>的输出token要发给<code>path[i+1]</code>和<code>path[i+2]</code>的pair池子，所以当<code>i=path.length-2</code>的时候，<code>i+1</code>为最后一个token，此时发送的对象为<code>_to</code>，也就是输出给指定的用户地址而非Pair合约。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="swapexactethfortokens">swapExactETHForTokens</h3>
<p><code>swapExactETHForTokens</code>的逻辑基本类似，但是所有用到<code>ETH</code>的地方都必须做<code>WETH</code>的转换，比如一开始就要求 <code>path[0]</code>必须为<code>WETH</code>。然后将<code>ETH</code>转换为<code>WETH</code>后发给第一个交易对，开始<code>swap</code>的流程。</p>
<pre><code class="language-solidity">function swapExactETHForTokens(uint amountOutMin, address[] calldata path, address to, uint deadline)
    external
    virtual
    override
    payable
    ensure(deadline)
    returns (uint[] memory amounts)
{
    require(path[0] == WETH, 'UniswapV2Router: INVALID_PATH');
    amounts = UniswapV2Library.getAmountsOut(factory, msg.value, path);
    require(amounts[amounts.length - 1] &gt;= amountOutMin, 'UniswapV2Router: INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT');
    IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amounts[0]}();
    assert(IWETH(WETH).transfer(UniswapV2Library.pairFor(factory, path[0], path[1]), amounts[0]));
    _swap(amounts, path, to);
}

</code></pre>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<p>在Router中主要实现的是对于参数的处理，无论是流动性的变更还是swap，在用户提供了<code>token</code>和<code>amount</code>之后，路由合约会进行相应的计算，得到满足条件的<code>amount</code>参与到swap流程中，保证了传递给swap方法的参数合法性。同时也要负责多链路swap的有序进行，实现不同流动性池之间的传递。</p>

</div>
